findings.description: Carel Fredrik Kolbe died on 21 February 1876 and was buried in Cape Town; the Dutch Reformed Church burial entry indexes him as Carel Fredrik Kolbey and gives no age or relatives.

details.place: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa

supporting_sources: South Africa, Dutch Reformed Church Registers (Cape Town Archives), 1660-1994 — burial entry for Carel Fredrik Kolbey, died 21 Feb 1876
